messages:
mike: Heads-up — spotted a 410 on an external schema link in runtime/troubleshooting.md (line under 'kv cache mismatch'). The partner removed the endpoint and our runbook preview shows a broken link when the incident play runs.

lena: thanks — can you paste the exact snippet? :mag:

mike: snippet:```markdown
See partner schema: https://partner.example.com/schema/v2
```
I grabbed an archived copy that matches what we relied on: https://archive.example.org/partner-schema-v2.json

anya: that runbook is surfaced by the platform-oncall automation, so the broken URL is noisy for oncall. we should snapshot it in our KB or replace with an internal static path.

sam: proposal: add a snapshot under /kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json and replace the external link with that. include a footnote noting it's a frozen copy + timestamp/source. small PR.

lena: +1. please include a sed one-liner in the PR to make it easy for reviewers.

mike: opened tiny PR with the snapshot and a single-line footnote. sed one-liner in PR description:```bash
sed -i "s|https://partner.example.com/schema/v2|/kb/snapshots/partner-schema-v2.json|g" runtime/troubleshooting.md
```
PR body mentions snapshot date (2026-03-18) and asks to rotate if partner restores canonical endpoint.

anya: assigning to me for review, will sanity-check the wording and changelog note. pinging @lena for footnote wording.

lena: LGTM on wording; optional: add rotation cadence (e.g., review every 6 months).

platform-oncall: FYI — once merged I will rerun the runbook preview and confirm the UI no longer surfaces the broken link. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: CI linkcheck ran for the PR — no new 4xx in docs build. (one unrelated image flake).

sam: should we add a 1-line changelog entry in the runbook so future oncall folks know why the snapshot exists?

mike: will add the changelog line and squash it into the PR.

anya: reviewing now, aiming to merge before EOD. drop :eyes: on the PR if you can co-review.

lena: :eyes:

platform-oncall: confirmed after merge — runbook preview no longer shows broken partner link. closing thread. :tada:
